outcome: pelvic floor muscle strength (abnormal resting muscle strength, abnormal fast-twitch muscle)
cohort: The study included 845 women recruited from a postpartum outpatient clinic of Nantong Affiliated Hospital between August 2019 and October 2021.
finding: The study identified maternal age, parity, immigrant status, economic income, gestational constipation, gestational weight gain, and vaginal inflammation as risk factors for Pelvic Floor Dysfunction (PFD) one month postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher rates of abnormal resting muscle strength compared to vaginal delivery, but a decreased incidence of urinary incontinence.
